newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Trust to sell pension unit to CIBC.
newsitem.headline: Canada Trust to sell pension unit to CIBC.

text.p: CT Financial Services Inc's wholly-owned unit Canada Trust Co said on Wednesday that it has agreed to sell its C$200 billion pension, institutional trust and custody business to CIBC Mellon Global Securities Services Co for about C$150 million.
Canada Trust said the deal is subject to regulatory approval and is expected to close within three months.

It said Canada Trust will retain its client record-keeping business which maintains individual records for client capital accumulation plans, including money-purchase pension plans, group Retirement Savings Plans, deferred profit sharing plans and employee savings plans.
Canada Trust will use proceeds from the sale to further develop its position as a provider of personal financial services to Canadians.
"This is a winning deal all around," Edmund Clark, President and Chief Executive Officer of Canada Trust, said in a statement.
CIBC Mellon is a joint venture between the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce and Mellon Bank Corp.
